text: Good evening, I'm so sorry to trouble you at this hour. I have my granddaughter staying, she is 7, and she has a temperature of 38.1 and says her throat is sore. She is still drinking her juice and water quite happily though. I did check her neck as I remembered reading about that, and she can put her chin down to her tummy with no bother at all. I expect I'm fussing over nothing but I would feel better knowing whether I can give her something tonight. Thank you, and apologies again.
